name: Question 9
problem:
Consider the following partitions:

- ${P}_{1}={{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}}$ is a partition of the interval $[2,6]$

- ${P}_{2}={{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}}$ is a partition of the interval $[4,6]$

Calculate  ${\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{i}+{x}_{i-1})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j},$ where $Δ{x}_{i}={x}_{i}-{x}_{i-1}$ and $Δ{y}_{j}={y}_{j}-{y}_{j-1}.$

Question 9
?

Consider the following partitions:

  • P1={x0,x1,…,xm} is a partition of the interval [2,6]

  • P2={y0,y1,…,yn} is a partition of the interval [4,6]

Calculate ∑i=1m∑j=1n(xi+xi−1)ΔxiΔyj, where Δxi=xi−xi−1 and Δyj=yj−yj−1.

a
36
b
18
c
64
d
32
e
96
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Using the product rule, we can write the summation as

∑i=1m(xi+xi−1)Δxi⋅∑j=1nΔyj.

Note that ∑j=1nΔyj is just the length of the interval [4,6]. So, we have

∑j=1nΔyj=6−4=2.

For the sum over i, we can evaluate as follows:

∑i=1m(xi+xi−1)Δxi=(x1+x0)Δx1+(x2+x1)Δx2+⋯+(xm+xm−1)Δxn=(x1+x0)(x1−x0)+(x2+x1)(x2−x1)+⋯+(xm+xm−1)(xm−xm−1)=(x12−x02)+(x22−x12)+⋯+(xm2−xm−12)=(x12−x02)+(x22−x12)+⋯+(xm2−xm−12)=−x02+xm2=xm2−x02=62−22=32

Combining our results, we finally arrive at

∑i=1m(xi+xi−1)Δxi⋅∑j=1nΔyj=32⋅2=64.
